scope: Prefetch-aware timing of both physical refill reads, sharing the existing fetch burst instead of manual wait-only accesses
hardware: Linux x86_64 cloud host; Temurin 21.0.8; Maven 3.9.11; no physical presentation or sustained-playback claim

change.before: Refill reads charged raw wait costs and never engaged the prefetch stream. This repeated a page-start nonsequential wait during the second refill, or on the next physical read after a target two instructions before the page.
change.after: Refill reads use the common private fetch path with their already-physical addresses. The CPU retains logical PC/stream identities and arbitrates DMA before each read. No lookahead is added to the refill addresses.
change.unchanged: WAITCNT constants, LCD phases, DMA activation and IRQ assertion/entry policy; no RNG writes or image masks.

validation.sdk_rapc: JDE 7.1 / ECJ 4.6.1 / RAPC: No errors; development COD/JAD

game_gate.scope: Candidate override source is byte-identical to the reviewed BusTiming.java. Two fresh control captures match the previous baseline; all reference formats/assets/frame budgets remain explicit. No strict full RGB/PCM result is relaxed.

strict_save_comparison.scope: Read-only diagnosis; keys and play time remain decoded differences. Classification never relaxes strict whole-file or RGB/PCM comparison.

strict_stream_comparison.note: Exact hashes expose differences; mGBA filtering and guest timing can both affect audio. No perceptual tolerance is applied.

player_save.scope: The generation-4 save restores x=6,y=8,map=3/0 and money 3000. Current host/reference files differ in 704 bytes with 37 unclassified activity bytes (35 before); strict save/full RGB/PCM still fail. Successful reloads do not qualify full save compatibility.

trace_report.scope: RAM changes observed between public CPU steps, not exact bus timestamps or retirement events; unchanged stores are absent. No observation callbacks or guest writes. Input save is read only; full RGB/PCM hashes are retained.

old_state_scope: Existing format-1 snapshots load without changing their bytes; corrected host and actual new CLDC classes agree on full state/RGB/PCM over 120 future frames. This does not assert pre-correction future execution is unchanged.

reproduction.micro: Run all three IRQ-return adapters with --full-trace --extended-pages. Compare with tools/compare_irq_refill.py. Host shared mismatches become zero, but exit 1 and all 92 model disagreements remain. Default outputs stay identical to the old 162-row fixture.
reproduction.tests: mvn verify; tools/test-with-console.sh; tools/blackberry.sh with pinned JDE/ECJ; tools/test-cldc-core.sh
reproduction.games: Repeat the 15 scenarios/frame budgets listed below with fresh owned save/output paths. Preserve every previously reference-exact RGB frame and strict full RGB/PCM outcomes.
reproduction.saves: Repeat the LeafGreen 4190-frame overworld save route and two 1700-frame cross-loads. Trace RAM word 0x03005000 read-only; require all traced RGB/PCM/backup/count outcomes equal the untraced run.
